rawFindings.title: Invalid call to offsets.setDesiredOffsets with incorrect arguments
rawFindings.explanation: The added line calls offsets.setDesiredOffsets with positional arguments [tokenAfterOperator.range[1], node.range[1]], tokenAfterOperator, 1, which is inconsistent with typical usages, where the first argument is expected to be a token or node, and the second an offset (number). Passing an array as first argument likely causes runtime errors or incorrect behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the call to use correct argument types for offsets.setDesiredOffsets, likely offsets.setDesiredOffsets(tokenAfterOperator, 1) or offsets.setDesiredOffsets(tokenAfterOperator, desiredOffset), removing the array argument.
